subject: Request: short runway bump while PO clears
messages:
From: Claire Wu <claire.wu@cerebrahealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cerebrahealth.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short runway bump while PO clears

Hi Nikhil,

Quick note from procurement — our legal team has put the PO on hold for one last review (we expect sign-off within 5-7 business days, but the finance queue is slower than usual). We are in the middle of a live evaluation and the team is using the sandbox heavily; if the workspace expires we risk losing momentum and some of the critical prompt/eval work we shared during the demo.

Would Redwood be willing to temporarily extend our sandbox access or grant a small credit top-up so we can keep the tests running until the PO is processed? We need something that covers roughly another week of usage (est. 1,000–1,500 generation credits). Happy to provide the PO number as soon as legal clears.

Appreciate any short-term option you can offer — this is an important evaluation for us.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Wu
Head of ML Integrations
Cerebra Health

Attachment: procurement_hold_notice.txt (attachment stub)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Wu <claire.wu@cerebrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short runway bump while PO clears

Hi Claire — thanks for the heads up and for being candid about timing. We can absolutely help keep the evaluation live while your PO moves through legal/finance.

Proposed temporary accommodation:
- A 7-day sandbox extension starting today (we'll set the expiry to 2027-04-08 23:59 PDT).
- A one-time 1,500 generation-credit supplement applied to the Cerebra sandbox.

Before I apply this, two quick asks so we can track and comply with internal approvals:
1) Please confirm which team members need access (list of emails).
2) Share any expected PO number or ETA once available so billing can reconcile the temporary credit.

I'm looping in Marissa and Dev for approvals and to confirm the wording on a simple addendum we typically use for short-term credit accommodations. I'll attach the approval stub once we're aligned.

If that sounds OK, reply with the participants and I will push the credits and set the expiration.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: temporary-credit-approval.pdf (approval stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short runway bump while PO clears

Thanks Nikhil — approved.

I authorize a 7-day sandbox extension and a 1,500-generation credit supplement for Cerebra Health (deal RDW-2027-CH-0921) with the following guardrails:
- Credits are limited to inference generation only (no account-wide billing transfers).
- The extension and credits expire automatically on 2027-04-08 23:59 PDT.
- Cerebra must provide the PO number or a written procurement ETA within 5 business days; if we do not receive confirmation we will not extend further without executive review.

Please use the attached addendum template to get a signature (simple e-sign will do). Dev — can you apply the credits and set the expiry once Nikhil confirms the recipient list? Please cc billing for reconciliation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: credits-addendum-template.docx (docx template)
